description: The customer explicitly asks for a human
Abusive language, or a customer who is plainly angry
Third or later contact about the same order
Any mention of legal action, a consumer forum or a regulator
Any mention of physical harm or a product-safety hazard such as overheating, smoke, fire or injury
A refund or replacement worth more than 2,000 rupees
A refund, return or replacement request from an account that is flagged or under review for return abuse
The courier shows the parcel as delivered and the customer says it never arrived
